audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1 and 2 are credited to Darius in both layers — content win[0] and win[1] are 'Darius', and the full layer rates them 2/10 and 2.5/10 for Jayce — while this same entry's early section says 'Levels 1-2 are yours', whys[0] says 'a free gate-Q chunks him', whys[1] says 'out-trades a Darius who still has to reach you on foot', and spikes[0] calls it 'free chip'. The packet level chart gives both levels to Jayce.
audit.why: Riot's text supports the prose: Darius has no dash, Apprehend is a 26-second cooldown at rank 1 and only 535 range, and Hemorrhage needs stacks he cannot get without touching you. Rating the opening 2/10 tells a ranged poke champion to concede the two levels he most clearly owns, against a 51.9% matchup.
audit.corrected: phases[0] and phases[1] rated 7/10 with reasons that match the prose and carry the real numbers. The side fields could not be changed (see notes).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why for level 6 is champion-wide boilerplate ('six abilities against his four') and never states what Noxian Guillotine actually does.
audit.why: It is true damage, it scales with Hemorrhage stacks on the target, and its cooldown refreshes on a kill. _missing-interactions.json flags this pair for resistances-invalidated. 'Reassess every all-in at 6' does not tell the player that buying MR is not an answer.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the true damage, the stack scaling and the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimate's heal is mentioned five times across the page — 'empowered-Q heal', 'his empowered-Q heal and Stridebreaker stat-check', 'Q heal out-sustain' — but never where it comes from. Riot's Q text: enemies struck by the BLADE take more damage than those struck by the handle, and Darius heals based only on champions hit by the blade.
audit.why: This is the most actionable fact in the matchup and it is absent. Stepping toward Darius into the handle denies both the bonus damage and the entire heal — it inverts the instinct to back away, which walks you into the blade.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, the Key Ability Interactions entry, dontsFull[1] and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says to 'bait the Apprehend pull' and 'track Apprehend' without ever giving its cooldown, and the packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — by a wide margin the longest cooldown in his kit and the single best number on this page. A missed pull at rank 1 is a 26-second window, which is long enough to crash a wave and take a plate, not just to poke once.
audit.corrected: The 26s figure and the 535 range now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], both dos entries and phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Itemization entry recommends anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern' but says nothing about Apprehend's passive, which causes his physical damage to ignore a percentage of the target's armour.
audit.why: The same line prescribes Plated Steelcaps. Armour is a partially defeated stat in this matchup and the page never says so, while the anti-heal buy is correct but unexplained — it is Decimate blade heal it is answering.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names the armour shred and ties anti-heal to the Decimate blade.

notes: Four chart fields I could not correct: content win[0], content win[1], full phases[0].side and full phases[1].side all read 'Darius' and should read 'Jayce'. A six-character enum swapped for a five-character one cannot land inside the applier's +/-10% length band, so I corrected the two ratings and both phase reasons instead. This is the largest chart-versus-prose contradiction I found in my slice: the full layer opens the lane at 2/10 for Jayce while the prose directly above it says the first two levels are free, and the matchup sits at 51.9% over 1476 games. It needs a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass. Also worth noting for whoever reconciles the win rates: MC_WR_TABLES.jayce lists darius at 49.78 against the packet's 51.9, and the full layer's 'EVEN / 6-10' framing was written against the lower figure.
